rationale: CRS.pointToLatLng is a static method inherited by EarthCRS and EPSG3857 (no subclass overrides it). Map.unproject calls it through this.options.crs, which defaults to EPSG3857 in Map's options literal. CRSSpec.js also calls it on `const crs = EPSG3857`, a class alias. The resolver misses inherited static calls through a class-valued variable or options property, and no in-scope rule covers that.
prior_verdicts_assessment: All three prior fp-novel verdicts are correct. The first two cite Map.js:1003 accurately.
